title: July breaks drought and heat records in France: 'The issue of water is becoming absolutely critical'
subhead: With an average temperature of 24.9°C across the country, July 2026 was the hottest month ever recorded in mainland France since measurements began in the early 20th century. The unprecedented heat was accompanied by an equally exceptional level of soil drought, Météo-France warned.

Two French streamers convicted over violence preceding live death of associate
subhead: Naruto and Safine were found guilty of online violence and humiliation preceding the on-air death of streamer Jean Pormanove in his sleep. They received suspended prison sentences, fines, and a six-month ban on posting online.

title: How the French government is convincing banks to loan Le Pen funds for her campaign
subhead: A consortium of banks should allow far-right candidate Marine Le Pen to obtain a loan in France. In past campaigns, she took loans from Russian and Hungarian establishments after French banks were reluctant to be associated with her.

title: Aleksander Ceferin, the football administrator who forced Infantino to back down
subhead: As head of UEFA, Aleksander Ceferin was at the forefront of the opposition to FIFA head Gianni Infantino's plan to create a semi-private FIFA subsidiary – which he has since abandoned – and now seeks to swiftly force Infantino to resign.

title: After wildfires, southwest France faces puzzle of rebuilding a 'new forest'
